facts.fact: 三阳连珠：爆炸（Angelica 之火）撼城——Phos 之怒 molar-aching、地砖开裂「You believe I am weakened without my generals? Foolish. Faithless.」；天空异变「Because the Second Sun was rising, a matter of hours between sunrises shortened to seconds——an orbital phenomenon. Within a heartbeat the Third Sun dawned as well——firmament 近白」「三阳被拽离各自轨道、聚成一个 lopsided triangle」

Vitae 门开：神庙前暗影成形——quintessence 自廊柱涌出喂养——「murky, spiraling portal——The scent of spring water and mountain air and growing grass spread through the plaza. Vitae.」；「三阳之名在他血脉里低语：Great Walkmar, Honorable Risäl, Merciful Nikai」；Nikolas 尖叫
facts.anchor: The scent of spring water and mountain air and growing grass

facts.fact: 望塔机关：方尖石塔、锈门（手枪+Lucent 破门）、螺旋梯；顶室北望广场南望「数英里外的 sandstone complex」；「bell handle levers+brass plate——Century of Eclipse 时 ost Krülins 与 Divine City 祭司共建的防御工程：Noctus 门在南、需偏转攻击」；铜板周围雕纹=新刻的 Conjuration glyphs（连接神庙中的那些；Rian 认出 hexagram=aether 之符）——「It will connect all the lightspeed gates together. The ones in the Three Sisters, the inactive one by the sealed Noctus portal, and the one here……Together, they become a singular large lightspeed gate.」
facts.anchor: It will connect all the lightspeed gates together.

facts.fact: Astrum 噩梦回放：手按铜板——感知扩展至每座光速门；「三阳 magnify——solar flares 交织成一条 immense, disastrous ray——将穿过 Phos 的门把 Nexus 烧成废墟」；闪回「Suddenly he was not standing at the top of the watchtower but at the top of the Bone Palace——手持 Sunbringer Spear——光柱落向 jewel-toned 的 Astrum——stealing hundreds if not thousands of Noctan lives. Because of Phos. Because of him.」
facts.anchor: stealing hundreds if not thousands of Noctan lives.

facts.fact: 菱形连线：压住愧疚（花园里并肩淤青的兄弟、第一章自辩「You didn't have a choice. We were all doing what we had to in order to survive.」）——「clutched them with his magic and pulled」——金线自三座塔升起、Edwin 拉杆调孔——「forming the exact diamond Edwin had drawn in the air; its northern point was Zenith, its southern point the Divine City. The bottommost part just managed to stretch over the yawning portal into Vitae.」（手渐失知觉）
facts.anchor: forming the exact diamond Edwin had drawn in the air

facts.fact: Edwin 的补丁：「会吸收没错——但它是为反弹 Noctus 来袭而造——会把攻击折回原处」「At the suns. The suns that keep Solara alive.」「I—I may have neglected to mention that part before. But I didn't think it was pertinent at the time!」——Rian 不敢收手（Nexus 有母亲、Brailee、Saya、无数无辜者）；quintessence 之味「sprawling fields and star clusters……Everything big and small at once」
facts.anchor: deflect it back to where it came from.

facts.fact: 拔门改瞄：凭本能伸手——「Ed. Turn all the gates upward.」；「光速自体内点燃——aperture 上亮起 sigil：the glyph of aether containing the glyph of light——Divine City 的光速门被连根拔起、举到金线交汇处——硬接三重太阳耀斑（恰在 Vitae 门上方）」；「拉杆下调、以 lightspeed 把门再举高——旋转菱形——直到它不再对着太阳、而是对着『forcibly drawn them together 的那一位』」——「solar flare 轰进神庙：facade 炸裂、廊柱崩塌；cornerstone 穿过 Vitae 门——门 stutter 缩闭（或断其专注、或震乱神庙内的 Conjuration circles）」
facts.anchor: the glyph of aether containing the glyph of light

facts.fact: 章末伏兵：「Second Sun 最小——他却感到它的热度最烈。Honorable Risäl. A name that evoked judgment.」；Edwin「It worked!」——Rian 笑到一半僵住——「半毁神庙的尘瓦中，多个 sinuous 的形体正游入广场。Long feathered wings——像 Nikolas 身上长出的那种——自废墟中浮现」
facts.anchor: Honorable Risäl. A name that evoked judgment.
